description: Adds a tender to the signed-in company's 'Moje przetargi' — the same as 'Dodaj do Moich' in Przetargowy Janusz: a new entry in the first kanban column, 'Do przejrzenia' (one removed earlier comes back there). Its AI summary is not ordered — request_summary does that. A tender already there — also as its copy from another portal — stays as it is, and the answer gives the entry that is there. By tender_id (from search_tenders, list_matched_tenders or get_tender) or public slug. Returns the result (added / restored / already), the status and the workspace link. Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

slug.description: public slug, when there is no tender_id

name: add_to_my_tenders
title: Dodaj do Moich przetargów
